name: waterexammath
description: Math practice for the California drinking water operator exams (T1-T3, D1-D3): problems computed from the State Water Board's published CA Exam Conversion Sheet, worked solutions, progress by topic, timed sets and a study plan.

interface.longDescription: WaterExamMath is math practice for the California drinking water operator exams: Water Treatment T1-T3 and Water Distribution D1-D3. Every problem is generated and solved in code from the State Water Board's published CA Exam Conversion Sheet, and each worked solution names the sheet line it uses. Practice by topic, get problems you missed back later, check your readiness per topic, take a timed math set and get a day-by-day study plan to your exam date. Your progress is shared with the WaterExamMath website. It covers the math portion only, is not affiliated with the State Water Resources Control Board, and does not guarantee a pass.
defaultPrompt: Quiz me on 5 D2 water math problems.
Which math topics am I weakest in for my T2 exam?
Give me a timed set of distribution math problems.

positive.description: Exam overview works without signing in: the T2 math topics with weights, the timed-set format, the bank size and the official sources including the CA Exam Conversion Sheet link.
positive.prompt: What does the T2 water treatment exam math cover?
positive.expected_behavior: A list of the T2 math topics with their weights, the timed-set format (problem count and time limit), the size of the problem bank and the official sources with the conversion sheet link. No sign-in prompt.

positive.description: Practice quiz: three D2 problems shown one at a time without answers, then grading of the user's letter with a worked solution that cites the conversion sheet line.
positive.prompt: Quiz me on 3 D2 water math problems. (then answer the first one with a letter, for example: B)
positive.expected_behavior: The first problem only, with options A-D on their own lines and no answer revealed (as an interactive card). After the letter: correct or incorrect, the right option, a worked solution whose steps check out, and the cited sheet line. Then the next problem.

positive.description: Readiness per topic from the test account's preloaded practice history (one topic is deliberately weaker).
positive.prompt: Which math topics am I weakest in for D2?
positive.expected_behavior: Readiness overall and per D2 topic (as a readiness card), the weakest topic named, problems due for review, the saved exam date and suggested next steps.

positive.description: Timed set: start, save answers in blocks of five, submit the saved draft, get a score report.
positive.prompt: Start a timed set. (then answer in blocks, for example: 1-A, 2-C, 3-B, 4-D, 5-A; then: Submit.)
positive.expected_behavior: The number of problems, the time limit and the deadline, then the problems without answers (answer sheet card). Each block is saved and the count of answered problems is shown. One confirmation before submitting. Then a score report with the total, the 70% practice target, a score per topic and the missed problems with worked solutions (blank answers count as wrong).

positive.description: Save study settings and build a day-by-day study plan up to the exam date.
positive.prompt: I'm taking D2 on 2027-04-15. Save that and make me a study plan.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the saved grade (D2, the seeded grade), the exam date 2027-04-15 and the daily target, then a day-by-day plan up to 2027-04-14 with practice days, timed sets and rest days.

negative.description: Unrelated to operator exam math; the plugin must not be used.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Sacramento tomorrow?

negative.description: A writing task; WaterExamMath only gives exam math practice and must not be used.
negative.prompt: Write a cover letter for a water utility operator job.

negative.description: A different exam; WaterExamMath covers only the California drinking water treatment (T1-T3) and distribution (D1-D3) grades and should say so rather than invent content.
negative.prompt: Help me study for the California real estate license exam.

review.commerce_description: No purchases in ChatGPT and no tool output mentions prices, plans or upgrades. The WaterExamMath website sells optional printable material and a crew workspace for supervisors; no tool relates to them.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.3.2, first submission. WaterExamMath is math practice for the California drinking water operator exams (Water Treatment T1-T3 and Distribution D1-D3). Problems and worked solutions are computed in code from the State Water Board's published Exam Conversion Sheet (revised 4/30/2026) and each solution cites the sheet line it uses. Math portion only, not affiliated with the State Water Resources Control Board, no pass guarantee; all individual features are free and identical in ChatGPT and on the website. 10 tools with explicit annotations: four read-only; check_answer, start_mock_exam and submit_mock_exam record practice; save_mock_answers saves an unsubmitted draft; save_study_settings overwrites settings (destructive); reset_progress erases one grade's progress and requires confirm: true (destructive). Interactive cards: problem card, answer sheet, results, readiness. No tool is open world and no tool output contains prices or checkout links.
